run_inference_tracking: run video inference with YOLOv8 model and ByteTrack tracking to annotate and save output video
create_byte_track: create a ByteTrack tracker instance to associate object detections across video frames
create_box_annotator: create a BoxAnnotator to draw bounding boxes around detected objects on video frames
create_video_sink: create a VideoSink to write annotated video frames to a target output file
get_video_frames_generator: get a video frames generator to iterate over frames from a source video file
